title: Serenity by the Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: Serenity by the Sea blends upscale coastal design with laid-back charm, offering the perfect setting for a luxurious beach getaway. With four spacious bedrooms, including two king suites with private baths, this home comfortably hosts up to ten guests across its light-filled, open-concept layout. Every detail is thoughtfully curated—from high ceilings and designer furnishings to a fully equipped chef’s kitchen with premium appliances and ample workspace. The generous primary suite on the main floor offers a peaceful retreat, while the second-story lounge and entertainment room provide extra space to unwind. Outdoor living shines with three covered porches, including one with a swing bed and flat-screen TV, and a back patio perfect for al fresco dining. Guests can grill out, ride bikes to the beach just five minutes away, or relax with access to exclusive seasonal beach bonfires. With a full laundry room, premium linens, and a well-stocked kitchen, Serenity by the Sea makes every moment of your stay effortless and elevated.
